title: Lebschy 2024 costovertebral articulation longitudinal displacement at 28 N

quantity.name: longitudinal displacement at 28 N
quantity.definition: rib displacement under 28 N tension along local longitudinal axis

source.authors: Lebschy C, Gradischar A, Krach W, Krall M, Fediuk M, Krall A, Lindenmann J, Smolle-Juttner F, Hammer N, Beyer B, Smolle J, Schafer U
source.sample: 7 costovertebral articulation samples (rib + 2 adjacent vertebrae, ribs II, IV, VI, VIII) from 2 fresh unembalmed male cadavers (same donors K25, K35 as Gradischar 2022)

protocol.summary: Rib with its two articulating vertebrae (ligaments intact), refrigerated 5-7 C; vertebrae fixed; torsion about the rib rotation axis by a dead weight -5 N then pulling the rib end to +5 N at 0.29 deg/s (moment = F x rib lever lF, angle = atan(s/lF)); tension up to 28 N in local longitudinal, sagittal and transverse directions; 3 repetitions, 2nd and 3rd used. ROM NZ = rotation between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm; ROM EZ = rotation between -0.002 and +0.002 Nm/kg body mass.
how_to_simulate: Fix both vertebrae; apply a force at the rib end (lever lF per sample) to create torsion about the rib rotation axis
Report rotation between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm; apply 28 N tension in 3 directions and report displacement

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 text layer (digital PDF), median row as printed. Same two donors as Gradischar 2022 (costal cartilage) - shared donors.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
